crossRefs.note: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many…
You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them…
I will turn you around, and will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and…
and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
“There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down…
They have set her a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her; all of them uncircumcised…

translations.web: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
translations.bsb: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
translations.kjv: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
translations.asv: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who are gone down with the slain; in the terror which they caused by their might they are put to shame; and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
